text: Excellent service! My truck had an issue on the way into work, thankfully Diverse was on the way there! Joe and Ariel were able to get me back on the road in under 2 hours! They were kind and helpful every step of the way. I work for a dealership full time and this level of attention and immediate action does not exist in many places, Diverse is a true gem in this industry! These folks TRULY care about their customers. Thanks again for your support and assistance!

I came to them on the recommendation of a fellow motorcyclist. Joe does motorcycle inspections. he gets me in and out real quick, especially when it’s raining. I like the low-key vibes there. He provides a Keurig machine, and a USB charging station.

We had an issue with our truck while driving home to NJ on 422. We had no idea where to go, and found Desire on the internet. What a positive and excellent experience we had. They took us in immediately and diagnosed the issue and had us back on the road in no time, at an affordable price. They turned what could have been a terrible day into just a little delayed arrival at home. And as an added bonus when we got into the truck there was a bag of Halloween candy waiting for us to munch on - Yum! I would recommend them to anyone looking for an honest and trustworthy mechanic. Wish we could find a Comparable mechanic near our home in NJ. May be worth the two hour drive next time we need service!!!

Great price Diverse Autoworks offer the Best Price I have ever had! They are honest, reliable, flexible with their time, and highly courteous. I took my car here twice. Both times I was met with fast, efficient service, and the lowest price I have seen for quality work. My car is 11 years old and has 156,000 miles on it.

Had the state inspection and tire rotation and balancing done at Diverse Autoworks. It was a very positive experience. Scheduling over the phone was quick and easy. When I got there at the appointment time, they had everything set up already and I was out in minutes. The waiting area is nice, clean, spacious and smoke-free. Communication about the car status was via phone message and the invoice was attached. Nobody tried to call me and upsell me something - really appreciate that. We will take all our other cars there in the future as well. Thanks for making this as painless as possible.

For over 4 years, I have trusted Diverse Autoworks with the maintenance of my cars. Their staff, who are both knowledgeable and skilled, efficiently resolved any issues my car had, while providing clear explanations along the way. The customer service I received was exceptional, with friendly and attentive staff who kept me well-informed throughout the process. The quality of their workmanship was commendable, leaving my car in excellent condition. Their pricing was fair and transparent, providing great value for the services rendered. Overall, I highly recommend Diverse Autoworks for reliable and top-notch car maintenance and repairs.

As a new customer, I have had outstanding service from Diverse Autoworks. The office is immaculate and from what I can see the garage it is also clean and organized. I have had my vehicles there a few times and the experience has been very positive each time. They accommodated schedules for drop off and pick up and are excellent at communicating updates. They are comparable to other shops in price, I trust their work and how well they care for my vehicle’s. It’s great to see a local company who values their customers, take great pride in their work and provide excellent technical service. Give them an opportunity to earn your business.

Really great experience at Diverse getting my forester realigned today. Everyone here was incredibly nice and I'm happy to have found another local business to support. Ariel was incredibly helpful in getting my car scheduled quickly, and even called the day before as a reminder of the appointment. Diverse got the alignment done quickly for a fair price, and my car drives beautifully now. Very clean and organized shop as well. Will be bringing our other vehicles here from now on for everything I can't do in the home garage.
I am new to taking my cars to the Diverse team and am very happy wit their services and friendly team! Nice to have an independent shop in town to trust.

I've been going to Diverse Autoworks for nearly 2 years for numerous vehicles I own. On each visit they are friendly and Professional. They have fair pricing and the work is always done on time and of high quality. I had most recently taken in a vehicle to have it looked at prior to gifting it away and they provided a few suggestions and after work the car has never run better! They get 5 stars in my book and I would highly recommend taking your vehicle/s here too.

The folks at Diverse Auto really understand the meaning of customer service. They’re so nice and go well out of their way to be helpful. They went the extra mile when I was in a tough bind and it’s that kind of human empathy from a business that will win me as a customer for life. I’d recommend them to anybody.

Great experience at Diverse Autoworks! Had an issue with front end vibration and Joe and his team diagnosed it and solved the issue in no time. Great scheduling flexibility, fantastic service, competitive pricing, and friendly people. Give this small business with local ownership (Joe) a try and you won’t be disappointed.
Went for a tesla state inspection and tire rotation. It was easy to get an appointment and they are very pleasant to deal with. Would definitely go again.

Joe and his crew are the best. Great service, simple explanations and he goes out of his way to find affordable options if needed. Also like the option of paying for service over the phone allowing for after-hours vehicle pick-ups.
Very friendly and knowledgeable staff! They get the work done quickly and are thorough. They are also affordable and very clean as far as auto body shops go!

Took my nieces 2015 vw beetle there because dr. Side window didnt work. Diverse fixed it around $400 , worked for a week ,took it to VW they fixed it ,had to order new door VW stated that whoever fixed this ruined the door!! $2000 to repair!!! No Diverse for me!!!

These people are wonderful I came in for an emergency repair, and they took care of it for a great price and even went above and beyond. If I lived in the area I would come here for all my auto repair and service needs
I am so impressed and satisfied with everyone at Diverse. I was treated so well. I will recommend them to anyone who asks me. I will be a repeat customer.
Great car repair shop. We have been using them for years. Friendly, clean, reliable and knowledgeable.
Super friendly staff, always flexible, extremely clean and organized, and just fantatistic service. I wouldn’t take my car anywhere else!
These guys are awesome! Do you want someone who is honest gives you a good price and a break here and there go to Diverse!
Ariel was very helpful with ordering a part for my car.
Diverse is the best place to go! Joe is the best in the area and great to work with!
They are real good with work and inspection
Excellent service. Professional and friendly.
Honest and fair . Takes pride in their work.
Great shop
Excellent service
